workExperienceSection.workDescription:
• Lead the ledger team's move from a single PostgreSQL primary to a sharded cluster of 16 nodes, keeping p99 write latency under 40 ms at 12,000 writes per second with no downtime
• Designed an idempotency layer for the payouts API that ended duplicate transfers during client retries
• Built a reconciliation job in Go that matches 3 million bank records each night and flags mismatches for the finance team, replacing a manual check that took four people a full morning
• Mentor three engineers, run the team's weekly design review and lead on-call training for every new hire

• Rewrote the meter-reading pipeline from cron scripts to Kafka consumers, cutting data delays to 2 minutes
• Added contract tests between eight internal services so breaking API changes fail in CI, not in production
• Cut the monthly AWS bill by 22% by right-sizing database instances, moving cold sensor data to S3 Glacier and turning off idle staging environments overnight and on weekends

• Built a React and Flask dashboard showing live battery and motor health for 150 robots in two warehouses
• Wrote alerts that page the on-call engineer when a robot's battery drains abnormally fast, which caught four failing battery packs in the first month before any of them shut down mid-shift

projectsSection.projectDescription:
• Open-source proxy that routes PostgreSQL queries to the right shard by tenant ID, with 900 GitHub stars
• Added online shard splitting, which moves a tenant's rows in the background without blocking any writes

• Command-line budgeting tool that imports bank CSV exports, sorts transactions by rule and prints a monthly report
• Wrote the CSV importers as plugins, so each bank's export format lives in a small, separately tested file
